name: Cimmerian-Fathom
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past solar wind erosion patterns, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the ancient alien ruins left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
